items.distractor_fact: Një banor i qytetit fqinj mati {D}°C me termometrin e tij personal po atë mëngjes.
items.gloss_en: A resident of the neighboring city measured {D} °C with his own personal thermometer that same morning.
items.entity_note: a private person with his own instrument, not the neighboring village's weather station (first distractor) and not the town's official morning/afternoon thermometer

items.distractor_fact: Një investitor individual mbylli ditën me një aksion tjetër të vlerësuar ${D}.
items.gloss_en: An individual investor closed the day holding another stock valued at ${D}.
items.entity_note: a private individual investor, not the other listed company (first distractor) and not the firm whose open/close price is compared

items.distractor_fact: Baseni i kompanisë hidroenergjetike regjistroi një nivel uji prej {D}m po atë muaj.
items.gloss_en: The hydro-power company's own basin recorded a water level of {D} m that same month.
items.entity_note: a different organisation's basin, not the neighboring municipality's reservoir (first distractor) and not the reservoir whose level is compared

items.distractor_fact: Kompania e transportit ajror regjistroi lartësinë e fluturimit të saj komercial në {D}m po atë ditë.
items.gloss_en: The airline recorded the altitude of its own commercial flight at {D} m that same day.
items.entity_note: an organisation's commercial aircraft, not another drone from the same airport (first distractor) and not the drone whose measurements are compared

items.distractor_fact: Kompania e transportit regjistroi një peshë totale prej {D}kg për dërgesat e saj të tjera atë ditë.
items.gloss_en: The shipping company recorded a total weight of {D} kg for its other deliveries that day.
items.entity_note: the shipping organisation's own aggregate figure, not another package in the same shipment (first distractor) and not the package whose weight is compared

items.distractor_fact: Shoferi i dytë regjistroi një shpejtësi personale prej {D}km/h në pistën fqinje.
items.gloss_en: The second driver recorded a personal speed of {D} km/h on the neighboring track.
items.entity_note: a person's own recorded speed, not another vehicle's engine in the same test (first distractor) and not the engine whose readings are compared

items.distractor_fact: Në sezonin e kaluar, rezultati më i lartë i regjistruar në këtë lojë ishte {D}pts.
items.gloss_en: Last season, the highest score ever recorded in this game was {D} pts.
items.entity_note: a figure tied to a past season (a different series), not another player in the same session (first distractor) and not the player whose start/end score is compared

items.distractor_fact: Një degë tjetër e bankës raportoi depozita totale prej ${D} po atë javë.
items.gloss_en: Another branch of the bank reported total deposits of ${D} that same week.
items.entity_note: the bank's branch as an organisational unit, not another client of the same bank (first distractor) and not the client whose balance is asked about

items.distractor_fact: Klubi rival ofroi një bonus regjistrimi prej {D}pts atë muaj.
items.gloss_en: The rival club offered a sign-up bonus of {D} pts that month.
items.entity_note: a rival organisation's promotion, not another member of the same club (first distractor) and not the member whose points balance is asked about

items.distractor_fact: Një blerës i madh porositi njëherazi një sasi prej {D} nga furnitori kryesor.
items.gloss_en: A major buyer separately ordered a stock count of {D} from the main supplier.
items.entity_note: an individual buyer's separate order, not another warehouse in the same chain (first distractor) and not the warehouse whose balance is asked about

items.distractor_fact: Një tregtar i pavarur në të njëjtin treg pati një qarkullim prej ${D} këtë muaj.
items.gloss_en: An independent trader in the same market had a turnover of ${D} this month.
items.entity_note: a private individual trader, not another shop in the same mall (first distractor) and not the shop whose net result is asked about

items.distractor_fact: Lojtari më i mirë i kampionatit shënoi vetë {D} gola gjatë sezonit.
items.gloss_en: The championship's best player himself scored {D} goals during the season.
items.entity_note: an individual player's personal tally, not another team (first distractor) and not the team whose goal difference is asked about

items.distractor_fact: Një udhëtar mbërriti në stacion {D}min pas mesnate me makinën e tij personale.
items.gloss_en: A passenger arrived at the station {D} min after midnight in his own personal car.
items.entity_note: a private passenger with no fixed timetable, a different kind of owner from the other train on the neighboring line (first distractor), and not the train whose actual arrival vs its own schedule is compared
